# tenable fixtures

SYNTHETIC, hand-made CSV exports following the published Nessus CSV
columns (`nessus-export.csv`) and a Tenable.sc-style export
(`tenable-sc-export.csv`). Plugin 10863 output follows the plugin's
documented layout; certificates and fingerprints are those of the synthetic
test certificates. Includes rows that must be skipped (other plugin, port
0, no host, no certificate, no identity, short row, duplicate). Re-record
from a real Nessus or Tenable VM export of a lab and redact addresses.
